summary_zh: 一个意外出生的孩子离家出走，在山中遇见一位老人，渐渐明白该怎样回到母亲身边。

sentences.text: It was a little girl who first saw the mysterious shape in the distance.
sentences.translation_zh: 最先看见远处那个神秘身影的是一个小女孩。

sentences.text: As the shape moved closer, she saw that it was a heavily pregnant woman.
sentences.translation_zh: 那身影走近后，她看清来人是个身怀六甲的女人。

sentences.text: Shy but brave, the little girl moved nearer to the woman.
sentences.translation_zh: 小女孩虽然害羞，却很勇敢，她朝那女人又走近了一些。

sentences.text: “We must keep her with us,” the little girl’s people decided.
sentences.translation_zh: “我们得让她留下来和我们住在一起，”小女孩的族人决定。

sentences.text: “We’ll keep her and her child safe.”
sentences.translation_zh: “我们会保护她和她的孩子。”

sentences.text: The child was soon on its way.
sentences.translation_zh: 孩子快要出生了。

phrases.gloss_zh: 即将到来，这里指快要出生

sentences.text: “Push!”
sentences.translation_zh: “用力！”

sentences.text: “Bring blankets!”
sentences.translation_zh: “拿毯子来！”

sentences.text: “Water!”
“Puuuuussssshhh!!!”
But when they saw the baby, everyone jumped back in shock.
sentences.translation_zh: 但当他们看到孩子时，人人都吓得往后一跳。

sentences.text: “A donkey?!”
sentences.translation_zh: “一头驴？！”

sentences.text: Everyone began to argue.
sentences.translation_zh: 大家开始争吵。

sentences.text: “We said we would keep mother and child safe, and that’s what we’ll do,” said some.
sentences.translation_zh: 有人说：“我们说过要保护母子平安，就会做到。”

sentences.text: “But they will bring us bad luck!” said others.
sentences.translation_zh: 也有人说：“可他们会给我们带来坏运气！”

sentences.text: And so the woman found herself alone again.
sentences.translation_zh: 于是，女人发现自己又孤身一人了。

sentences.text: She wondered what to do with this awkward child.
sentences.translation_zh: 她不知道该拿这个难以照顾的孩子怎么办。

sentences.text: She wondered what to do with herself.
sentences.translation_zh: 她也不知道自己该怎么办。

sentences.text: But finally she had to accept that he was her child and she was his mother.
sentences.translation_zh: 但她终于不得不接受，他是她的孩子，她是他的母亲。

sentences.text: Now, if the child had stayed that same, small size, everything might have been different.
sentences.translation_zh: 要是孩子一直那么小，一切也许会不同。

sentences.text: But the donkey child grew and grew until he could no longer fit on his mother’s back.
sentences.translation_zh: 可驴孩子越长越大，直到母亲的背再也驮不下他。

sentences.text: And no matter how hard he tried, he could not behave like a human being.
sentences.translation_zh: 而且无论他多努力，都无法像人一样行事。

phrases.surface: no matter how hard he tried

sentences.text: His mother was often tired and frustrated.
sentences.translation_zh: 母亲常常感到疲惫又沮丧。

sentences.text: Sometimes she made him do work meant for animals.
sentences.translation_zh: 有时她让他干本来由牲畜做的活。

sentences.text: Confusion and anger built up inside Donkey.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子心里积起了困惑和怒火。

sentences.text: He couldn’t do this and he couldn’t do that.
sentences.translation_zh: 这个他做不了，那个他也做不了。

sentences.text: He couldn’t be like this and he couldn’t be like that.
sentences.translation_zh: 他不能这样，也不能那样。

sentences.text: He became so angry that, one day, he kicked his mother to the ground.
sentences.translation_zh: 有一天，他气得把母亲踢倒在地。

sentences.text: Donkey was filled with shame.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子满心羞愧。

sentences.text: He started to run away as far and fast as he could.
sentences.translation_zh: 他开始逃跑，尽可能跑得又远又快。

tokens.gloss_zh: 与后面的as组成程度结构

sentences.text: By the time he stopped running, it was night, and Donkey was lost.
sentences.translation_zh: 等他停下脚步时，已是夜晚，驴孩子迷路了。

sentences.text: “Hee haw?” he whispered to the darkness.
sentences.translation_zh: “咿啊？”他朝黑暗低声叫道。

sentences.text: “Hee Haw?” it echoed back.
sentences.translation_zh: “咿啊？”回声传了回来。

sentences.text: He was alone.
sentences.translation_zh: 那里只有他自己。

sentences.text: Curling himself into a tight ball, he fell into a deep and troubled sleep.
sentences.translation_zh: 他把身体紧紧蜷成一团，陷入沉沉却不安稳的睡眠。

sentences.text: Donkey woke up to find a strange old man staring down at him.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子醒来，发现一位陌生老人正低头盯着他。

sentences.text: He looked into the old man’s eyes and started to feel a twinkle of hope.
sentences.translation_zh: 他望着老人的眼睛，心中有了一线希望。

sentences.text: Donkey went to stay with the old man, who taught him many different ways to survive.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子去和老人一起住，老人教他许多生存办法。

sentences.text: Donkey listened and learned, and so did the old man.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子听了，也学了。老人同样在听、在学。

sentences.text: They helped each other, and they laughed together.
sentences.translation_zh: 他们互相帮助，也一起欢笑。

sentences.text: One morning, the old man asked Donkey to carry him to the top of a mountain.
sentences.translation_zh: 一天早晨，老人请驴孩子驮着自己到山顶。

sentences.text: High up amongst the clouds they fell asleep.
sentences.translation_zh: 他们在高高的云间睡着了。

sentences.text: Donkey dreamed that his mother was sick and calling to him.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子梦见母亲病了，正在呼唤他。

sentences.text: And when he woke up…
sentences.translation_zh: 而当他醒来……

sentences.text: … the clouds had disappeared along with his friend, the old man.
sentences.translation_zh: ……云朵消失了，他的朋友，那位老人，也不见了。

sentences.text: Donkey finally knew what to do.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子终于明白该做什么了。

sentences.text: Donkey found his mother, alone and mourning her lost child.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子找到了母亲。她孤身一人，正为失去孩子而悲伤。

sentences.text: They stared at each other for a long time.
sentences.translation_zh: 他们久久地望着彼此。

sentences.text: And then hugged each other very hard.
sentences.translation_zh: 然后紧紧地抱住了对方。

sentences.text: The donkey child and his mother have grown together and found many ways of living side by side.
sentences.translation_zh: 驴孩子和母亲一起成长，找到了许多相伴生活的办法。

sentences.text: Slowly, all around them, other families have started to settle.
sentences.translation_zh: 渐渐地，其他家庭也开始在他们周围安家。
